title: Meta's AI Writes Better Than Humans?
full_monologue: **Meta just released an AI that writes better than humans.** This isn't just another chatbot — it's crafting essays, scripts, and even poetry that rival human creativity. Imagine having a writer that never gets tired, never makes mistakes, and delivers perfection every time. But is this a breakthrough or a threat? Let’s see what this AI can really do. The implications are huge — from content creation to education. What do you think? Are we entering a new era of AI-powered creativity?
